text: The dataset that shows there was forest on the property in 2020 is the "Global Forest Change" dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) provided by the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD). This dataset observed tree cover in 2000 and recorded tree-cover loss events, including one in 2020. However, the European Commission Joint Research Centre's "Global Forest Cover 2020" dataset (GFC2020 V4) did not observe any forest in 2020 on the property.
